parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.description: Provide a valid email for contacts.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of records per page. Values above the maximum are reduced to the maximum.

parameters.name: date_window
parameters.description: Send `strict` to adopt the 180-day window starting now that will be the standard on 05/02/2027. Without it, current behavior is preserved.

parameters.name: occurrence_date_from
parameters.description: Start date of the occurrence date filter. With `date_window=strict`, if omitted it is derived from `occurrence_date_to` (180 days before) or, in the absence of both, from today.

parameters.name: occurrence_date_to
parameters.description: End date of the occurrence date filter. With `date_window=strict`, if omitted it is derived from `occurrence_date_from` (180 days after) or, in the absence of both, is today.

parameters.name: amount_from
parameters.description: Minimum transaction value, in reais and with sign — debits are negative, as in the `amount` field of the response. Use period as decimal separator.

parameters.name: amount_to
parameters.description: Maximum transaction value, in reais and with sign — debits are negative, as in the `amount` field of the response. Use period as decimal separator.

parameters.name: amount_abs_from
parameters.description: Minimum value in modulus, ignoring the sign. Use for "above X, inflow or outflow".

parameters.name: amount_abs_to
parameters.description: Maximum value in modulus, ignoring the sign.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category code, or comma-separated list. Consult the catalog at `GET /v2/financial/statement_categories`. Unknown codes are ignored.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Returns only transactions changed from this moment (ISO 8601). Used for incremental synchronization.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text search in the transaction description sent by the bank (`description`). Matches any part of the text, without distinguishing uppercase, lowercase, or accents — `manutencao` finds `MANUTENÇÃO`.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Use `compact` to receive only the essential fields of each transaction.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return in each transaction. Takes precedence over `view`. An unknown field results in `422`.

parameters.name: pagination
parameters.description: Use `keyset` for cursor pagination, stable when new transactions arrive during the scan. The response brings `next_cursor` instead of URLs.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor returned in `pagination.next_cursor`. Only has effect with `pagination=keyset`.
